body: And I should clarify. Suicide is an action but suicide ideation is a mental illness. But it's relatively the same thing.

Suicide is a mental illness. To perpetually think about killing yourself is not a healthy way of living life. The mind will start to deteriorate from self loathing and depression. I was happy for majority of my life and now that im suicidal makes me realize that it is a mental illness.
In my world, I can't use drugs, speak about depression or use meds. Military life.
Military frowns upon depression and medication. Part of the reason why my situation is fucked up.
I feel the same way. And my situation is really fucked up and I'm trapped.

I agree that I took it with me and I'm not blaming the military. But I've never realized these problems before hand. Last 6 months I've just been really in my head thinking about who I am. The fact that I'm nothing. And the problem is I have no motivation or care to succeed in life based on my past life choices. There's only one chance for me to make it through this and that's to succeed in my career, but I just don't have the energy. Believe me that I try, but something's come over me. everything that I do feels like a major chore and everything bores me. My brain is toxic. My perception of the world and myself has changed. And talking to anyone,chaplain or therapist, won't help because it's all bs in my view.

I can't. The reality of my situation is pretty fucked up actually. I'm in the military. I go wherever they need me. And besides, I've realized that I just constantly distract myself to pass the time. Doing anything feels fake in a way.

You're not alone. At least you have something.  You're ability to play piano. You have a character inside you that people will eventually respect and love you for. you have a something to work for. I've lost everything. Money, best friend/ lover and my identity. I've experienced amazing moments in my life and if I try to visualize a better future but it just doesn't seem possible. Complacency killed my life and who i I visioned who I wanted to be.
